findings.observed: The policy admits read_memory_address.board_id,address,size, but the pinned registered handler accepts board_id,address,width,length.
findings.expected: Each admitted parameter must exactly match the pinned registered guarded API.
findings.reproduction: A width call is rejected as unlisted; a size call reaches a handler with no size parameter.
findings.impact: A policy-approved debug operation is denied before dispatch or invalid at the server.
findings.no_fix_consequence: C3 cannot certify the read-memory route as pinned, executable, and fail-closed.
findings.smallest_fix: Use width and length with reviewed ranges, then add a static policy-versus-signature regression case.
findings.complexity: Low: one method entry and focused negative and positive tests.
findings.regression_risk: Low: it confines an already invalid method description to the actual server contract.
findings.verification_cost: Low: static signature and policy coverage without MCP or hardware.
findings.alternatives: Removing read memory avoids the mismatch but unnecessarily removes required diagnostic coverage.
findings.cost_benefit: The deterministic API mismatch blocks a governed operation; the localized correction has negligible compatibility cost.

findings.observed: The broker checks only an existing server directory and limited identity baseline; it does not bind exact clean server identity or equality of method, arguments, policy, plan, permission, authorization, and admission across stages.
findings.expected: Dispatch must prove the exact clean pinned server and compare all required call fields and hashes across every immutable stage.
findings.reproduction: Substitute another checkout at the fixed path, or create a signed proposal then same-identity later artifacts with changed method, arguments, or plan; the shown checks do not reject either substitution.
findings.impact: A physical operation can be attributed to a reviewed proposal while executing under different server or call authority.
findings.no_fix_consequence: C3 cannot establish C4/C7/C31/C39/C49 provenance or fail-closed authorization for mutating calls.
findings.smallest_fix: Verify exact clean Git server identity before launch and compare one canonical bound-call object/hash at every stage before dispatch and result acceptance.
findings.complexity: Moderate but localized to the existing acceptance broker and focused tests.
findings.regression_risk: Bounded: it rejects only mismatched or unpinned evidence already forbidden by contract.
findings.verification_cost: Moderate static tests for changed revision, arguments, authorization/plan, and stale admission; no hardware.
findings.alternatives: Record names, free-standing hashes, and operator discipline leave the demonstrated substitution paths open.
findings.cost_benefit: This is the core physical-operation trust boundary; canonical comparison is cheaper and safer than accepting unverifiable evidence.

findings.observed: Manager triage is declared required, but validate_finding_triage is not called by production controller or completion code; only its unit test calls it.
findings.expected: A gated review/test result with findings cannot be accepted until its owner records a hash-bound closed one-for-one triage decision.
findings.reproduction: Submit a valid finding-gated RESULT.json; lane_controller validates only FINDINGS.json and returns VALID without reading triage evidence.
findings.impact: The project-required cost-benefit gate can be bypassed, allowing untriaged findings to enter or disappear from manager workflow.
findings.no_fix_consequence: The finding contract remains advisory at the manager boundary and cannot support required C68 decision evidence.
findings.smallest_fix: Add a plan-specific manager completion validator requiring a create-once triage artifact and validate it before accepting a nonempty gated submission.
findings.complexity: Low to moderate: one narrow integration point and focused manager-path tests.
findings.regression_risk: Low: apply only to existing opt-in project review/test templates, preserving ordinary coding invocations.
findings.verification_cost: Low: PASS-empty, FAIL-without-triage, stale-hash, duplicate/missing-decision, and valid-triage static tests.
findings.alternatives: Prompt-only manager discipline does not fail closed and contradicts manager_triage_required.
findings.cost_benefit: The missing call makes an explicit requirement non-operative; a narrow opt-in integration is proportionate.
